item.title: Iranian president, FM reemerge in public despite Netanyahu’s threatened '10 plagues' of war
item.summary: Senior Iranian leaders appeared at pro-regime rallies in Tehran after weeks out of public view, signaling defiance despite Israeli claims of targeting top officials; Araghchi: 'There are no negotiations, there is an exchange of messages. We will not accept a ceasefire'

item.title: Israel pushes US to hit Iran energy sites, says it could collapse regime
item.summary: Officials in Jerusalem said a target bank focused on energy facilities and critical infrastructure has already been prepared, with any potential strike now dependent on a decision by Trump

item.title: Netanyahu: Iran no longer poses an existential threat to Israel
item.summary: PM claims Iran had invested nearly $1 trillion in its military buildup, including nuclear and missile programs, and now he says that investment has now been 'wasted'

item.title: Billions for terror: Israel says Iran doubled Hezbollah funding since last war
item.summary: IDF says Tehran sent Hezbollah about $2 billion over the past year, roughly twice its usual annual support, helping the group rebuild after the 2024 war and sustain heavy rocket and drone fire in the current conflict

item.title: Israel says it has completed strikes on vital targets in Iran
item.summary: IDF says Air Force had put nearly all predesignated 'vital and strategic' targets out of operation, including military-industrial and nuclear-related sites, while pressing attacks in Tehran and opening a new ground line in southern Lebanon

item.title: IDF strike in Beirut kills Hezbollah Southern Front commander
item.summary: Military says Hajj Yusuf Ismail Hashem oversaw Hezbollah operations in southern Lebanon, including rocket fire and aerial attacks toward Israel, as well as plans targeting civilians and soldiers
